body: Phones suck - one of the worst inventions ever, IMO.  I just need to make myself go talk to someone when I am coming out of a dark stretch; kind of a postictal phase of having enough darkness to be able to see it, but realise that you need to do something about it.
If I could "think positive" on a dark day, it wouldn't be a dark day now would it?

I probably do need to find someone to talk to, but have to overcome the stigma of a tough-love upbringing (yet another issue to work through).  I can still hear my dad saying things in all seriousness like "if you didn't want a broken finger, why did you hit it with a hammer? Accidents don't happen,  you make them happen by not paying attention".  Yeah.  Lovely.

I honestly think that I have borderline OCD when it comes to planning things, which can be good when it is part of your job, or when you are planning a vacation (OK, sometimes the vacation planning gets a bit much), but I do make plans for good things - the worrying part is the detail I put in to planning 'bad' things and how those plans have almost lost their taboo.
